therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: EGFR monoclonal antibody blockade combined with DNA synthesis inhibition and DNA crosslinking
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell proliferation inhibition through EGFR pathway blockade and DNA damage
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Chemotherapy-naive KRAS/BRAF wild-type stage IV biliary tract and gallbladder cancer patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Response rate using RECIST criteria at end of cycle 2

results.dose_information: Panitumumab 6 mg/kg IV days 1 and 15, oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 IV days 1 and 15, gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 IV days 1 and 15

context.duration: Treatment cycles every 4 weeks, followed until progression or death
